changelog:
Version 3.0.0 – Online Duels

NEW: Online duels (optional)
- Duel friends online from the duel screen: create a room and share the 4-letter code, or join one from the list of open rooms.
- Each player uses decks built from their own collection.
- Fair play: duels are refereed by the server, so your opponent never sees your hand or face-down cards.
- Safe by design: names are randomly generated (roll until you like one) and chat is quick messages only, so nobody can type anything offensive.
- Privacy: only your generated name, your deck and your moves are sent. No account, no Steam ID, nothing kept after the duel ends. The connection is encrypted.
- Off by default. To switch it on, enable it in the config tab of the Real TCG Overhaul mod manager, or set Enabled = true under [Multiplayer] in BepInEx\config\dan.ygodueltable.cfg. The first time you open it, a screen explains exactly what's sent.

NEW: Update notifications
- When a new version is out, a message appears after your save loads showing what's changed, with buttons to open the download page, be reminded later, or skip that version.
- Switch it off with CheckForUpdates = false in the same config file.

Shop
- Pack prices lowered: market price is now around £4.40–£5.10 a pack (previously £8–£12). Boxes follow automatically.
- Fixed the YuGiOh Card Shop phone app showing a large box behind its icon.

Duels
- The AI no longer plays Mystical Space Typhoon, Twister, Dust Tornado and similar cards on its own Spells/Traps when you have none to target.
- Card pictures load much faster: they're read from your PC and saved after the first download.

Updating
- Delete your old Dan's YuGiOh Expansion folder and install the new version.
- Your save may keep the old pack prices for an in-game day before settling at the new ones.
